title: parser
intro:
To start the simulation, many parameters must be specified and state variables
must be given an initial value. It is the responsibility of the ’parser’ component to
read these data from an external source (typically a setup file), and convert them
into the internal format.
    Used by Toplevel @ input (see 107.30, page 626) .

sections.name: file
sections.desc: Read a setup file containing lots of parentheses.
